notes:
Antigravity: BaoCut now connects through agy acp, enabling BaoCut tools and action approvals in Plan, Ask and Full Access modes. BaoCut tools no longer trigger a second native approval. Requires Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 or later; update with agy update.
Antigravity sessions: Existing native conversations can resume through ACP. Developer instructions are added to the system prompt for new native sessions without duplication on resume. Model changes preserve reasoning-level model IDs, Flash models are recommended, and Windows discovery recognizes the official installer location.
Background commands: Antigravity turns now stay open until background commands finish and the agent follows up, preserving command results and replies. Interrupting the waiting turn cancels it. Daemon commands and scheduled tasks do not keep a turn open.
Known limits: Messages sent while a background command runs remain queued until the turn ends; interrupt to send them sooner. When the follow-up has no usage update, the turn can wait up to two minutes after its last activity. Changes to developer instructions take effect in a new native session. Real Google-account end-to-end use has not been verified.
The macOS package requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. CUDA and Vulkan variants require compatible GPU drivers.
